title: Pastel Seamless Diagonal Stripe Digital
author: Josehysf
description:
20 Pastel Seamless Diagonal Stripe Digital Papers | 
Add a soft and charming touch to your creative projects with this collection of 20 Pastel Seamless Diagonal Stripe Digital Papers. Featuring clean diagonal stripe patterns in a variety of soft pastel color combinations, this collection provides simple and versatile backgrounds for a wide range of creative projects.
Each design features a seamless repeating diagonal stripe pattern, making these digital papers perfect for scrapbook projects, stationery, invitations, planners, crafts, backgrounds, and more.
What’s Included:
• 20 Seamless Diagonal Stripe Digital Papers
• JPG Files
• PDF Files
• High Resolution
• 300 DPI
• 12 × 12 Inches
Specifications:

• Pattern Style: Seamless Diagonal Stripes
• Color Style: Soft Pastel Colors
• Size: 12 × 12 Inches
• Resolution: 300 DPI
• File Formats: JPG & PDF
Perfect For:
• Scrapbooking
• Card Making
• Invitations
• Journals & Planners
• Printable Crafts
• Stickers
• Party Decorations
• Stationery Designs
• Digital Paper Projects
• Backgrounds
• Craft Projects
Soft pastel colors and simple diagonal stripes make this collection a versatile choice for elegant, cute, and modern creative projects.
